rule: per template under "coded only" (sequence; tree and graph without their gene step; event frequency; blank), pooled over the declared seeds: at least 30 patients with a store candidate and an index window, and at most 30% of the distinct child types (PLAN keys) with a candidate unresolved; the whole tree and graph templates refused for their gene step only; the share over all candidates and without C001, and stated findings, reported

setting.window: from the second seizure, 24 months (the page's own)
setting.free_text: off (coded records only); the comparison: present (stated findings)
setting.translator: trajectory/store_request.js with codedOnly "store" and rises asked for
setting.store: patterns/store_conditions_coded.py (profile execution-store-conditions-1.3, exclude_kinds ["mention"]), through the dispatcher with D43's post-pass for counts (patterns/store_conditions_counts.py)
setting.converter: patterns/synthetic_ingest.py emitting series, diary summaries labelled as period readings

independence: not independent children (D36 review, M1): C001 is the scripted reference child in every seed, and every other child takes archetype, sex, birth year and overrides from the generator's fixed PLAN; only the draws vary with the seed
